# @agents-js/wake-types

> WakeAdapter BASE type + shape-discriminated union (in-session-push, translator-inject, spawn-with-signal) for the AJS-89 HYBRID wake-transport architecture. Pure types — no runtime.

## Installation

```sh
bun add @agents-js/wake-types
```

## API

<!-- Auto-generated from JSDoc -->

### Functions

- **`isKnownWakeAdapterShape`** — Narrow an arbitrary string to {WakeAdapterShape} via set membership. Useful at boundary read sites (parsing serialized envelopes, validating external input).
- **`isWakeSignalExpired`** — Return `true` if the signal has expired (wall-clock past {WakeAdapterBase.expiresAtMs}). Optional `now` parameter for deterministic testing — defaults to `Date.now()`.
- **`makeWakeIdempotencyKey`** — Construct a {WakeIdempotencyKey} from a raw string. Pure brand application — no validation. The gateway is responsible for ensuring the key is stable across retries of the same logical signal.
- **`makeWakeSignalId`** — Construct a {WakeSignalId} from a raw string. Pure brand application — no validation. The gateway is responsible for ensuring uniqueness of the underlying value (typically a ULID or UUID).

### Constants

- **`KNOWN_WAKE_ADAPTER_SHAPES`** — Canonical set of wake-adapter shape strings, derived from {KNOWN_WAKE_ADAPTER_SHAPES_RECORD} so adding a shape to {WakeAdapterShape} forces this set to widen in lockstep.
